content.introduction: The next Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate decision is due on Wednesday, April 29, 2026, at 18:00 GMT. The US Federal Reserve announces its decisions regarding interest rates eight times a year during Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings, approximately every six weeks. The federal funds rate target range is currently set at 3.50% to 3.75%, where it was left unchanged at the Federal Reserve’s latest meeting on March 18, 2026.

About the FOMC Meeting calendars and informationTranscripts and other historical materialsFAQs. ### Meeting calendars, statements, and minutes (2021-2027). The FOMC holds eight regularly scheduled meetings during the year and other meetings as needed. Links to policy statements and minutes are in the calendars below. The minutes of regularly scheduled meetings are released three weeks after the date of the policy decision. The FOMC makes an annual report pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act. The FOMC FOIA Service Center provides information about the status of FOIA requests and the FOIA process.

The [Federal Reserve](https://www.cnbc.com/federal-reserve/) on Wednesday approved its first interest rate hike in more than three years and indicated another is to come, as part of an effort aimed at combating inflation brought on by spiraling oil prices and other factors. In a move that [markets widely anticipated](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/14/counting-the-votes-warsh-faces-tough-battle-as-fed-girds-for-expected-rate-hike.html), the central bank’s Federal Open Market Committee voted 12-0 to increase its key interest rate by a quarter percentage point, or 25 basis points. “Inflation remains elevated,” the committee said [in its brief post-meeting statement](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/16/september-fed-statement-redline.html). ## [](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/16/fed-rate-decision-september-2026.html)Highly anticipated. ## [](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/16/fed-rate-decision-september-2026.html)Fed rarely moves once. The 10-year note has risen about a quarter percentage point since [Warsh’s remarks](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/28/kevin-warsh-jackson-hole-federal-reserve-inflation.html) at the Fed’s Jackson Hole, Wyoming, symposium on Aug. 28. In the wake of the decision, [Treasury yields were lower,](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/16/treasury-yield-bond-market-fed-decision.html) a signal that investors were encouraged by the central bank’s attempt to tamp down inflation. *   [](https://www.facebook.com/cnbc/). *   [](https://www.twitter.com/cnbc/). *   ![Image 14: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Icon](https://static-redesign.cnbcfm.com/dist/17269f1b6083fd5f61be.svg)[Your Privacy Choices](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/16/fed-rate-decision-september-2026.html).

# When is the next Fed interest rate decision? ## The next Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate decision is due on Wednesday, April 29, 2026, at 18:00 GMT. The US Federal Reserve (Fed) announces its decisions regarding interest rates eight times a year during Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings., approximately every six weeks. ## What is the Fed interest rate? At its latest meeting on **March 18, 2026**, the FOMC **held interest rates unchanged**. ## What date is the next Federal Reserve interest rate meeting? **The next Federal Reserve meeting is scheduled for April 28–29, 2026.**‍. The federal funds rate target range is currently set at **3.50% to 3.75%**, where it was **left unchanged at the Federal Reserve’s latest meeting on March 18, 2026**, following a series of rate cuts in late 2025. ### What is the effect when the Federal Reserve increases interest rates? ## What time is the Fed rate decision? ### **Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate**.
